item.title: Rotta The Hutt Has a STAR WARS Six Pack in New Image
item.description: A new image of Jeremy Allen White's Rotta the Hutt in The Mandalorian and Grogu shows a gladiator slug who is very different than his dad Jabba. The post Rotta The Hutt Has a STAR WARS Six Pack in New Image appeared first on Nerdist.

item.title: DOCTOR WHO Christmas Special Could Connect to Rose Tyler Episode
item.description: Fans think that the 2026 Doctor Who Christmas special will be a sequel of sorts to “Journey’s End,” which aired way back in 2008. The post DOCTOR WHO Christmas Special Could Connect to Rose Tyler Episode appeared first on Nerdist.

item.title: Seth MacFarlane Says ‘No Plan’ for TED Season 3 Because Show Is ‘Really Expensive’
item.description: Creator Seth MacFarlane says there is "no plan" for Ted season 3 because the CGI-heavy show is "really expensive" to produce. The post Seth MacFarlane Says ‘No Plan’ for TED Season 3 Because Show Is ‘Really Expensive’ appeared first on Nerdist.

item.title: EVANGELION 30th Anniversary Short Gives Asuka the Ending She Deserves

item.title: Tiffany Had No Idea Her Song Would be in STRANGER THINGS
item.description: '80s pop star Tiffany had no idea her song was used in Stranger Things 5 until she watched the scene. She loved it. The post Tiffany Had No Idea Her Song Would be in STRANGER THINGS appeared first on Nerdist.

item.title: Elijah Wood Doesn’t Want Anyone Else Playing Frodo
item.description: Elijah Wood has made it very clear how he feels about anyone playing his iconic character Frodo Baggins while he's still around. The post Elijah Wood Doesn’t Want Anyone Else Playing Frodo appeared first on Nerdist.
